## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区过滤 (必须)

```sql
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'  -- 或 'regional'
```

### 预算窗口过滤

```sql
AND substr(budget_start_datetime, 1, 10) <= '${grass_date}'
AND substr(budget_end_datetime, 1, 10) >= '${grass_date}'
```

### placement 过滤 (固定值)

```sql
AND placement = 9  -- Display Ads 固定
```

LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live d

WHERE d.grass_region = upper('${region}')

## Common Aggregations

### Display Ads 净消耗 (下游主要读入场景)

```sql
-- 精度说明: 2022-10-26 前后精度缩放不同
-- 之后: expense_amt_usd/1000.00 (expense_amt_usd 已由 CPM/100000 计算)
-- 之前: expense_amt_usd/100000.00/1000.00 (旧数据需多除 100000)
SELECT shop_id
     , ads_id
     , entrance
     , placement
     , pricing_type
     , campaign_id
     , SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date >= DATE('2022-10-26')
               THEN expense_amt_usd / 1000.00
               ELSE expense_amt_usd / 100000.00 / 1000.00
          END) AS raw_display_ads_revenue_usd_1d
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_display_ads_revenue__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region = upper('${grass_region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND substr(budget_start_datetime, 1, 10) <= '${grass_date}'
  AND substr(budget_end_datetime, 1, 10) >= '${grass_date}'
GROUP BY shop_id, ads_id, entrance, placement, pricing_type, campaign_id
```

### Display Ads 按 campaign/shop 汇总消耗

```sql
SELECT campaign_id
     , shop_id
     , SUM(expense_amt_usd / 1000.00) AS expense_before_tax
     , SUM(expense_amt_usd / 1000.00) AS expense_after_tax
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_display_ads_revenue__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY campaign_id, shop_id
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 全量写入逻辑 (regional tz_type)

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dws_advertise_display_ads_revenue__reg_s0_live
  PARTITION (tz_type = 'regional', grass_region, grass_date)
SELECT display_ads_traffic.ads_id
     , entrance
     , pricing_type
     , placement
     , shop_id
     , budget_start_datetime
     , budget_end_datetime
     , impression_cnt
     , ROUND(cpm_local / 100000, 2) AS cpm_local
     , ROUND(cpm_local / 100000 / exchange_rate, 2) AS cpm_usd
     , ROUND(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000, 2) AS expense_amt_local
     , ROUND(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000 / exchange_rate, 2) AS expense_amt_usd
     , click_cnt
     , campaign_id
     , upper('${region}') AS grass_region
     , DATE('${grass_date}') AS grass_date
FROM (
    SELECT ads_id, entrance, pricing_type, placement, campaign_id, grass_region
         , SUM(impression) AS impression_cnt
         , SUM(non_fraud_click) AS click_cnt
         , MAX(cpm) AS cpm_local
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND placement = 9
      AND slot_id IS NOT NULL
      AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
) display_ads_traffic
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ads_id, shop_id, budget_start_datetime, budget_end_datetime
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND tz_type = 'regional'
      AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
) display_ads ON display_ads.ads_id = display_ads_traffic.ads_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, exchange_rate
    FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
) exchange_rate_info ON display_ads_traffic.grass_region = exchange_rate_info.grass_region
WHERE substr(CAST(budget_end_datetime AS string), 0, 11) >= DATE('${grass_date}')
```

### Snippet 2: local 时区写入 (BR/ID/MX)

```sql
SET TIME ZONE '${timezone}';

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dws_advertise_display_ads_revenue__${region}_s0_live
  PARTITION (grass_date)
SELECT display_ads_traffic.ads_id
     , entrance, pricing_type, placement, shop_id
     , budget_start_datetime, budget_end_datetime
     , impression_cnt
     , ROUND(cpm_local / 100000, 2) AS cpm_local
     , ROUND(cpm_local / 100000 / exchange_rate, 2) AS cpm_usd
     , ROUND(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000, 2) AS expense_amt_local
     , ROUND(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000 / exchange_rate, 2) AS expense_amt_usd
     , click_cnt, campaign_id
     , DATE('${grass_date}') AS grass_date
FROM (
    SELECT ads_id, entrance, pricing_type, placement, grass_region, campaign_id
         , SUM(impression) AS impression_cnt
         , SUM(non_fraud_click) AS click_cnt
         , MAX(cpm) AS cpm_local
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND grass_date >= DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND grass_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
      AND DATE(from_unixtime(timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) < DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)
      AND DATE(from_unixtime(timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) >= DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND placement = 9
      AND slot_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
) display_ads_traffic
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ads_id, shop_id, budget_start_datetime, budget_end_datetime
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND tz_type = 'local'
      AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
) display_ads ON display_ads.ads_id = display_ads_traffic.ads_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, exchange_rate
    FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
) exchange_rate_info ON display_ads_traffic.grass_region = exchange_rate_info.grass_region
WHERE substr(CAST(budget_end_datetime AS string), 0, 11) >= DATE('${grass_date}')
;

ALTER TABLE dws_advertise_display_ads_revenue__reg_s0_live
  ADD IF NOT EXISTS PARTITION (grass_region = '${region}', tz_type = 'local', grass_date = '${grass_date}')
```

### 分区写入策略

- **regional tz_type** (MY, PH, SG, TH, TW, VN): 直接 `INSERT OVERWRITE ... PARTITION (tz_type='regional', grass_region, grass_date)`，按 `grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')` 过滤原始数据
- **local tz_type** (BR, ID, MX): 先写入 region-local 分表，再 `ALTER TABLE ... ADD PARTITION` 到主表。原始数据过滤使用 timestamp 精确范围 + grass_date 两天窗口 (`grass_date >= DATE('${grass_date}') AND grass_date <= DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)`)
- **BR special**: 有 `ads_id = 19473362 AND timestamp >= 1663688089` 的反作弊过滤
